# creative-it

> creative-it Software Consulting e.U. is an AWS Serverless and Agentic AI
> consultancy run by Günther Wieser, based in Gösing am Wagram, Austria.
> One specialist, not an agency: serverless architecture on AWS Lambda,
> DynamoDB and API Gateway; GDPR-compliant AI agents on AWS Bedrock;
> fractional CTO work; and cloud cost optimization. Nearly 35 years of
> software development experience. The site is bilingual: English at the
> root, German under /de/.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.creative-it.com/services/): the four services with scope and deliverables
- [AWS Serverless Architecture](https://www.creative-it.com/services/aws-serverless/): event-driven systems on Lambda, DynamoDB and API Gateway — zero-ops, production-ready
- [Agentic AI & GDPR Compliance](https://www.creative-it.com/services/agentic-ai/): custom AI agents on AWS Bedrock with EU data residency, GDPR-compliant by design
- [Fractional CTO](https://www.creative-it.com/services/fractional-cto/): C-level technology strategy and architecture for a few days per month
- [Cost-Optimized Cloud & AI](https://www.creative-it.com/services/cloud-optimization/): FinOps, right-sizing and reserved capacity — typical savings 40–70%

## Background & Proof

- [About Günther Wieser](https://www.creative-it.com/about/): founder story — software since 1991, this company since 1997, serverless since 2016, agentic coding since 2025
- [Agentic Coding (live stats)](https://www.creative-it.com/agentic-coding/): real GitHub metrics of AI coding agents shipping production code at creative-it
- [How the site's AI works](https://www.creative-it.com/how-it-works/): architecture behind the site's own AI features (AWS Bedrock, Lambda, DynamoDB, RAG)
- [Tech Stack Advisor](https://www.creative-it.com/tech-advisor/): AI tool that recommends an AWS architecture for your project
- [AI Agent Visualizer](https://www.creative-it.com/ai-agents/): interactive demo of multi-phase agentic reasoning on AWS Bedrock
